verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the trial page's claim that users can "cancel and remove your data at any time". That is a first-party deletion capability, but it appears only in a trial context. Encryption, permissions and audit logs are adjacent security controls, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, granular deletion controls for AI/agent data or conversation context, documented deletion procedures or timelines, and independent corroboration.
